notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first only - requests + bs4/lxml against live site, no block encountered (200 on all requests). robots.txt checked first: User-agent ClaudeBot explicitly Allow: /, plus a general Disallow list (checkout/app/customer/etc, none of which apply here) - full HTTP access permitted, no need to escalate to Playwright or Claude-in-Chrome. (3) home-decor/decor-accessories/decorative-boxes/ - all products are decorative wooden/marble boxes and tissue boxes (display objects), not storage containers - excluded per same rules. (4) Beds listed as 'with storage' / 'without storage' (e.g. Damien, Laine, Felice) are a bed attribute/variant, not a storage category or product - excluded, no fabrication of a synthetic Storage row for a furniture attribute. No cushions, curtains, rugs, bedding, towels, blankets, throws, table linens, or any other textile product/category found anywhere in nav, sitemap, or category pages checked - site sells lighting, fans, furniture, and hard decorative accessories only. QTY: n/a - no qualifying rows to quantify. Both textile_rows and storage_rows are correctly empty per brief Sec3 ('An empty array is a valid, correct answer - do not force a row').
